SELECT r.reported_reserve_usd - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_usd) FROM reserve_components c WHERE c.report_date='2025-06-30'),0) FROM reported_balances r WHERE r.report_date='2025-06-30'

SELECT (SELECT CAST(SUM(c.amount_usd) AS REAL) FROM reserve_components c WHERE c.report_date='2025-06-30') / (SELECT r.circulating_rlusd FROM reported_balances r WHERE r.report_date='2025-06-30') * 10000 - (SELECT CAST(SUM(c.amount_usd) AS REAL) FROM reserve_components c WHERE c.report_date='2025-05-30') / (SELECT r.circulating_rlusd FROM reported_balances r WHERE r.report_date='2025-05-30') * 10000
